Vasarosnameny Jewish Cemetery 3

Jewish Cemetery · Kossuth út 29, Hungary

Demolished. This is the third of at least three Jewish cemeteries across the modern territory of Vásárosnamény — a cluster that includes a separately documented site in the village of Vitka, elsewhere in this collection. Established in 1865, this cemetery was demolished at an unknown time and built over with a gymnasium. It served the same broader Vásárosnamény Jewish community, which peaked at 896 people in 1941 under the leadership of Rabbi Elias Kohn, a father of 15 children who held the Orthodox community together until his own deportation to Auschwitz on Passover 1944, where he and his wife were murdered.
